subject.title: feat(agents): per-agent outbound A2A allowlist override

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.list[].tools.agentToAgent.allow` as an outbound-only per-agent A2A authorization contract now, or should this wait for the broader session-visibility permission model?
rationale: The patch adds a new core config and plugin-SDK-visible authorization shape for cross-agent session tools, which is a product/security-boundary choice beyond the mechanical normalization defect.

options.title: Accept after focused repair
options.body: Normalize exact allow entries, remove the manual changelog edit, rebase, and land the focused outbound-only contract while broader visibility work remains separate.

options.title: Defer to broader permission design
options.body: Pause this branch and fold per-agent A2A into the canonical broader design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/59149 or the per-capability work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48785.

options.title: Redesign before merging
options.body: Ask for an explicit maintainer design covering outbound, inbound, and fallback semantics before accepting any new config surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after focused repair
recommendation.body: Normalize exact allow entries, remove the manual changelog edit, rebase, and land the focused outbound-only contract while broader visibility work remains separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared session access helper history and broader config/product boundary make Peter Steinberger the strongest available routing candidate from the current-main history.
